text:
Lena Ortega: Hi all! First day on infra. Got my laptop but stuck adding my SSH key to the dev repo. Git push asks for passphrase but key not listed in account. Also new here — what's the team's usual lunch routine? I can bring empanadas tomorrow.

Maya Lin: welcome Lena! Add your public key to https://git.redwood.com/settings/keys — if you don't see that page, your SSO might not be fully provisioned yet. I'll ping @IT Support.

Carlos Vega: hey Lena, I'm your onboarding buddy. We do a quick 1:1 at 11am to walk through repo access and runbooks. Lunch is usually group order Wed/Thu; empanadas sound great.

IT Support: Hi Lena 12	0	 we provisioned your SSO but public key missing. Send over the output of `ssh-add -L` (paste only the keys). If ssh-agent doesn't list it, run `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "lena@redwood.com"` then `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`.

Lena Ortega: thanks! `ssh-add -L` returns nothing. I'll generate a new ed25519 and paste in the settings.

Onboard Bot: New hire Lena Ortega assigned buddy: Carlos Vega. Checklist: sso_provisioned: true, ssh_key_added: false, slack_invite: true.

Maya Lin: PS we have a quick script to set git config and generate keys: `./scripts/onboard-ssh.sh` in the onboarding repo. I'll add you to that repo in a sec.

Lena Ortega: added key and can push now 44d. Thanks for the pointers. Also fun fact: I keep a tiny rooftop apiary and made my own sour honey last month 41d36f. Can bring samples (tiny jars) to Friday's show-and-tell.

Carlos Vega: amazing — we love snacks and demos. Welcome to Redwood!

HR Bot: Welcome Lena! Please complete the benefits form: https://redwood.inference/hr/forms/benefits. Orientation at 9:30 in #all-hands.

IT Support: Verified ssh_key_added: true. Repo invites pending for infra-runbooks. Will update when invites sent.

Lena Ortega: sweet, thanks everyone. See you at 11am 1:1 and during lunch 374.
